unavailable.title: Couldn't load the solver
unavailable.text: The server didn't respond just now. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Solver not found
notFound.text: The link may be incomplete. Pick a solver from the store to continue.

platformFree.title: {name} is free
platformFree.text: This solver is already included in the platform: no price, no license. Just connect Solvers to your AI and start using it.

gone.title: We couldn't find this Pix on this account
gone.text: It may have been generated by another account. If you already paid, the purchase goes to the account that generated the Pix. Generate a new code to continue here.

sessionEnded.title: Your session ended
sessionEnded.text: Sign in to the same account to keep following this Pix. If you already paid, the purchase is completed for that account once the payment is confirmed.

pix.offline: We couldn't confirm right now; trying again.
pix.nothingCharged: You haven't been charged. Generate a new code to continue.

due.title: This Pix's time limit has ended
due.text: If you already paid, the purchase is completed in a moment and continues here. If you haven't paid yet, generate a new code.

pix.simulatedNote: Test charge: this code can't be paid at a bank. Use the button below to simulate the payment.
pix.realNote: Open your bank app, choose Pix and scan the QR code or paste the code. The confirmation shows up here on its own.
pix.openMp: Open the Pix in Mercado Pago

recording.title: Payment received. Completing your purchase…
recording.text: No need to pay again: Solvers is recording it on the network for you.

slow.title: Your payment was received
slow.text: Completing the purchase is taking a little longer. You can close this screen: it will show up in your account on its own.

refund.title: We couldn't complete this purchase
refund.refunding: Your Pix was received, but the purchase could not be completed (for example, the last license was sold meanwhile). The amount is being refunded.
refund.refunded: The purchase could not be completed and your Pix was refunded.

pix.covers: Covers the purchase of {amount}: once the Pix is confirmed, Solvers completes it for you.

gone.title: We couldn't find this payment request on this account
gone.text: It may have been created by another account. If you already paid, the purchase goes to the account that created it. Create a new request to continue here.

sessionEnded.title: Your session ended
sessionEnded.text: Sign in to the same account to keep following this payment. If you already paid, the purchase is completed for that account once the payment is found.

solana.offline: We couldn't check right now; trying again.

expired.title: This payment request expired
expired.text: We didn't receive a payment for it. Create a new request to continue.

failed.title: This payment didn't go through
failed.text: Create a new payment request to try again.

due.title: This payment request's time is up
due.text: If you already paid, we'll find it in a moment and continue here. If you haven't paid yet, create a new request.

solana.qrAlt: QR code to pay {amount} with a Solana wallet
solana.howTo: Scan the QR code with Phantom or another Solana wallet and confirm. On your phone, tap Open in wallet. The confirmation shows up here on its own.
solana.onlyThis: Pay only through this QR code or button: it is what links the payment to your purchase.
solana.devnetHint: Test network: switch your wallet to devnet (testnet mode); get test USDC at <link>faucet.circle.com</link>.

seen.title: Payment found on Solana.
seen.text: Completing your purchase. No need to pay again.

recording.title: Payment received. Completing your purchase…
recording.text: No need to pay again: Solvers is recording it for you.

slow.title: Your payment was received
slow.text: Completing the purchase is taking a little longer. You can close this screen: it will show up in your account on its own.

refund.title: We couldn't complete this purchase
refund.refunding: Your payment was received, but the purchase could not be completed (for example, the last license was sold meanwhile). The USDC is being returned to the wallet that paid.
refund.refunded: The purchase could not be completed and your USDC was returned to the wallet that paid.
refund.viewRefund: View the refund on Solana Explorer

login.title: Sign in
login.cancelToSwitch: Cancel the payment to switch accounts.
login.devText: Sign in to receive the license in your wallet. In this test version, your browser creates a development wallet for you.
login.privyText: We'll send you an access code. No wallet? We create one for you automatically, and you can export it later.

task.title: Describe the task and the criteria
task.descPlaceholder: Tell us what the component needs to do, who it's for and any detail that matters.
task.deliveryHelp: If the solver doesn't deliver within the deadline, you can cancel the milestone and get its amount back, with no fee.
task.criteriaNote: The milestones and criteria are set by the solver's creator and apply to every task with a guarantee.

how.title: How the guarantee works
how.intro: Your payment is held and only released to the creator when the result meets the criteria agreed above. That way you only pay for results.

s1.title: 1. You pay and the funds are held
s1.text: The money doesn't go to the creator yet. It stays protected until the task is done.

s2.title: 2. The solver delivers in milestones
s2.text: Each milestone is checked against the criteria you saw. Manual review ones, like the plan, you check yourself.

s3.title: 3. You check a preview
s3.text: The preview comes with a watermark. The final version is only released after you approve.

s4.title: 4. Approved? Payment is released. Not passing? You dispute it.
s4.text: When you dispute, you point out which criterion failed. If the dispute is upheld, the money comes back to you. With no answer in {window}, approval is automatic.

level.newAccounts: New accounts can have up to {limited} in open guarantees. The full level goes up to {full} and rises as you buy and finish tasks without disputes.
level.overTitle: This task is over your guarantee limit
level.overText: Your level is {level}: up to {limit} in open guarantees, and you already have {open} in progress. There's room for {available} more and this task costs {total}.
level.toFullMax: {n, plural, one {# more purchase to go} other {# more purchases to go}} to reach the full level (up to {full}).
level.reduced: The limit is reduced because of lost disputes.
level.wait: Wait for a task in progress to finish before opening another.
level.info: Your guarantee level is {level}: up to {limit} in open guarantees ({available} more fit). It rises as you buy and finish tasks without disputes.
level.toFull: {n, plural, one {# more purchase to go} other {# more purchases to go}} to reach the full level.

singleTooBig.title: This guarantee needs at least 2 milestones
singleTooBig.text: Accounts on the limited level can only open single-milestone guarantees up to {max}, and this one costs {total}. Make more purchases to reach the full level.

limitsFailed.title: Couldn't check your guarantee limit
limitsFailed.text: Payment unlocks as soon as the limit is checked.

pay.title: How would you like to pay?
pay.pixText: You pay in Brazilian reais and Solvers completes the purchase for you.
pay.pixSoonText: Soon you'll be able to pay in Brazilian reais.
pay.walletText: Pay from your wallet's balance. The network fee is on us.
pay.lowText: You have {balance} and this purchase costs {total}.
pay.solanaText: Scan a QR code with a Solana wallet such as Phantom. Solvers completes the purchase for you.

review.title: Review and pay
review.agreeGuarantee: I've read and agree to the agreed criteria and to the automatic release after {window}.
review.agreeNew: I agree to the terms of use and to the license being issued in my name.
review.needTask: Give it a title and describe what you want to receive (minimum {min} characters).
review.protectedGuarantee: The funds are held until you approve each milestone.
review.protectedLicense: You get the license as soon as it's confirmed.
review.signing: Confirm in your wallet. Recording the purchase on the network…
review.priceChanged: The solver's price changed from {from} to {to}. Check the new amount and confirm again.

summary.rateNoteBrl: Shown in reais at the reference rate (US$ 1 = R$ {rate}). With the wallet, you pay the {symbol} price.

chargeClosed.title: The previous charge was closed
chargeClosed.text: It belonged to another account. Generate a new one for this account.

owned.title: You already have this solver
owned.text: The permanent license is already in your wallet. No need to buy it again.

creator.title: This is your solver
creator.text: Creators can't buy a license of their own solver. You can follow its sales in your creator panel.

soldOut.title: No licenses left
soldOut.text: All the licenses available right now have been sold, and nothing was charged. The creator can raise the limit later.

belowMin.title: Below the minimum purchase
belowMin.text: Every purchase must be at least {min}. This one can't go ahead right now.

paused.title: Purchases are paused for a moment
paused.text: Nothing was charged. Please try again in a little while.

unavailable.title: This solver isn't for sale right now
unavailable.text: It may be under review or temporarily unavailable. Nothing was charged.

errors.sessionText: Sign in again to continue. Nothing was charged.
